decision.title: Pagination for orders
decision.question: GET /orders is cursor paged (after, limit default 10, max 50) and returns nextCursor. What should lumen_books_orders expose?
decision.context: Recommendation: wrapper. Without nextCursor a caller cannot reach the second page. The customerId and status filters are exposed either way.

choices.label: after and limit arguments; return a page type with data and nextCursor
limit only; return the list (first page, no cursor)
